content.text:
The largest container is the 8-frame spanning rows 11-19, cols 8-17, roughly 9x10 with center around row 15, col 12.5. I'm taking the outside object—the 4-block pattern from rows 2-8, cols 2-9 with all its cells—and centering it within that container using the container's midpoint.

So the pattern (7 rows by 8 cols with concentric 4/3/5/8 layers) needs to land at rows 12-18, cols 9-16, aligning its own center with the container center.
